messages:
maria_support: Hey team — escalation from ticket #SF-4482. Customer says our autorouter invoked credit.account.create instead of refunds.create when they asked for a refund. High-impact (billing). Pinging @ravi_dev @ingrid_ml.

maria_support: Repro steps in the ticket: 1) Customer sends POST /v1/actions with the payload below 2) got 200 from credit.account.create and a store-credit was issued instead of refund 3) customer expected money back.

maria_support: Payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "user_id": "cust_90X",
  "amount": 49.99,
  "currency": "USD",
  "note": "customer requested refund for order 5543"
}
```

maria_support: Router logs: `router_decision: credit.account.create (score=0.62) refunds.create (score=0.38)`. Also shows fuzzy alias match: `aliases: [\"credit\", \"store_credit\", \"credit_account\"]` for credit.account.

ravi_dev: Thanks — can you paste the tool signatures we have onboarded for both services? suspect a schema overlap.

maria_support: Copied from registry: 
- credit.account.create: params: {amount: number, currency: string, reason: string?}
- refunds.create: params: {amount: number, currency: string, reason: string?}

ingrid_ml: Confirmed — identical parameter shapes -> high collision risk. Also credit.account has aliases containing the token "credit" which the intent classifier weights heavily. :thinking:

ingrid_ml: Quick mitigation options: 
- Short term: add a routing hint field in the client payload, e.g. "preferred_tool":"refunds.create" or "intent":"refund" which we can surface to the router.
- Medium: update the tool metadata to include a required discriminator (e.g. refunds.create requires `refund_reference` OR `refund_method`) so signatures diverge.
- Long term: improve alias weighting and train classifier to prefer negative-cash-flow intents for refunds.

aaron_escalations: For the customer we should do short-term fix + rollback if anything breaks. Can support patching our router to respect preferred_tool header.

maria_support: Customer is okay with workaround if we can do it quickly. They want full reimbursement, not store credit.

tool_router_bot: Automated log: `route_eval(user=cust_90X, input_tokens=27) => candidates=[{tool:credit.account.create,score:0.62,alias_match:0.48},{tool:refunds.create,score:0.38,alias_match:0.12}]`. Model_confidence_threshold=0.5; fallback_policy: none -> selected top candidate.

ravi_dev: I'll push a hotfix to prefer refunds.create when payload contains substrings like "refund" or "reimburse" in `note` or `reason`. Patch: add heuristic after scoring: if text contains refund-ish keywords then boost refunds.create +0.4 score. Quick to ship.

ingrid_ml: That heuristic will help but is brittle. Also add telemetry to record these keyword boosts so we can monitor false positives.

aaron_escalations: Timeline? Customer expects update today.

ravi_dev: Will create PR now, link in a minute.

maria_support: PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/merge-requests/2023 — attaching support ticket to the MR.

ingrid_ml: Also recommend we run a sweep for other tools with identical signatures (search registry) and tag them for manual disambiguation. I can run that report. :mag:

maria_support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with the temporary workaround and ETA. Please add notes to the support ticket.

aaron_escalations: Great. Follow-up: once hotfix is live, run a repro with the original payload and confirm refunds.create is selected (and refund issued). If not, revert.

tool_router_bot: Deploy note: hotfix deployed to staging at 1751240300, production schedule pending.

maria_support: Marking ticket P1 -> awaiting prod deploy. :eyes:
